itens.trecho: Qualquer semelhança com os filmes anteriores é quase mera coincidência. Dirigido por Rob Marshall, este filme é o quarto da saga "Piratas das Caraíbas". Neste filme, Jack Sparrow foge da prisão em Londres e parte em busca da lendária Fonte da Juventude como um prisioneiro do infame Barba-Negra e da sua alegada filha, Angélica, uma miúda espanhola que de…

View it as a spin off and it's a rollicking treasure seeking adventure. Ok lets have it out front right away, this particular writer loved the first film (Curse of the Black Pearl), was disappointed with the second (Dead Man's Chest) and positively found the third (At World's End) to be an incomprehensible bore.

At least this is bit shorter than the previous edition of the franchise, but sadly it isn't really any better. Rob Marshall has taken the helm and we have lost Orlando Bloom and Keira Knightley - who presumably recognised that the boat has sailed on this much weakened fantasy adventure series.
